documents_expected.why: call page: deadline, submission email, linked RFP and form
the RFP (Word): eligibility, match, outline, attachments, reporting

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be a state agency (including State Colleges and Universities), municipality, or not-for-profit organizations.
alt_quotes: State agencies (including State Colleges and universities), municipalities, and not-for-profit organizations are eligible to receive grants through this program.

eligibility.rule: Work on an inland waterbody in Connecticut
eligibility.quote: The study or project must be conducted on an inland waterbody located in Connecticut.

eligibility.rule: Target species already present before 20 October 2026
eligibility.quote: Note that target invasive species not present prior to October 20, 2026 in the study or project water body are not eligible for funding.

eligibility.rule: At most two proposals per applicant
eligibility.quote: An applicant may submit a maximum of two (2) proposals in response to this funding opportunity.

eligibility.rule: Completed within about 18 months of the contract
eligibility.quote: Proposed projects should be completed within approximately eighteen months from the contract execution date.

eligibility.rule: Awardees carry liability insurance naming DEEP
eligibility.quote: A successful awardee agrees to submit proof of professional liability insurance or Comprehensive General Liability Insurance (CGL)

documents.quote: Applicants must email completed application and any supporting information to DEEP.AISGrants@ct.gov
The Respondent must use a Cover Sheet capturing the following information:

documents.item: Waterbody ownership documents and access permission letters
documents.quote: Letters of permission should be provided for any non-applicant properties which must be crossed to gain access to the water body.

documents.item: NDDB determination where state-listed species are present
Conflict of interest disclosure and statement of assurances
documents.quote: G. Conflict of Interest - Disclosure Statement H. Statement of Assurances

effort.quote: Email questions to DEEP.AISGrants@ct.gov by November 3, 2026
Proposals must be received by the Official Contact on or before December 10, 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds are required and must equal or exceed 25% of the total project cost.

after_award.quote: At project completion, the awardee must submit a final report.

notes: Grants $10,000 to $75,000 (larger only if exceptional). Indirect costs can count as match but aren't funded. Unincorporated lake associations apply through their municipality or a non-profit. Everything is in Word files, read since gather-3; gather-2 had them unreadable and its hrefs kept a literal &.
